title: Chicago Salesforce slowness during carrier packet loss
resolution: Correlated to Chicago office circuit packet loss. Users routed through VPN alternate path until carrier fixed link.

title: VPN reconnect loop after US-East gateway patch
resolution: Updated VPN client to 6.4 and switched to us-west gateway during US-East degradation.

title: Data pipeline timeouts after firewall maintenance
resolution: Network team refreshed service-account allowlists after Friday maintenance.

title: Okta lockout after repeated password reset attempts
resolution: Helpdesk verified identity and unlocked Okta account. User signed in with existing MFA.

title: MFA reset required after lost phone
resolution: Escalated to IAM for identity verification and MFA reset.
